en1.full: language English<asr_text>The last train leaves at seven tonight. Please wait for me beside the old clock.
en1.last_clause: language English<asr_text>Please wait for me beside the old clock.

en2.full: language English<asr_text>I put the blue envelope on the table. The ticket was inside my coat all along.
en2.last_clause: language English<asr_text>The ticket was inside my coat all along.

en3.full: language English<asr_text>We found the path before the sun came up. Follow the river until you see a stone bridge.
en3.last_clause: language English<asr_text>Follow the river until you see a stone bridge.

zh1.full: language Chinese<asr_text>今天下午我们去公园散步，啊，记得带上雨伞，天气可能会变。
zh1.last_clause: language Chinese<asr_text>记得带上雨伞，天气可能会变。

zh2.full: language Chinese<asr_text>我把钥匙放在门口的桌子上。原来你已经找到那本书了。
zh2.last_clause: language Chinese<asr_text>原来你已经找到那本书了。

zh3.full: language Chinese<asr_text>火车明天早上八点出发。哼，我们在车站门口的钟楼下面见面。
zh3.last_clause: language Chinese<asr_text>哼，我们在车站门口的钟楼下面见面。
